According to the provisions of Motor Vehicle Act general law of the land, the technical grounds or reasons alone are not sufficient to exonerate the respondents who  SCCH-1 23 MVC No.4021/2018 C/w. 5673/2018 are owner and insurer of the vehicle or insurer of the vehicle to pay compensation to the victims or injured of the accident.

Hence, I have inferred that absence of the endorsement in the Driving Licence possessed by Santhosh Kumar to drive the vehicle No. KA-13-0455 as on the date of accident alone is insufficient to exonerate the respondent No.2 insurance company from indemnifying the owner of the vehicle in MVC 4021/2018.

Hence, I came to the conclusion that the respondents being owner, insurer of the vehicle No.KA-13-0455 are liable to pay compensation to Shivamma W/o Ashok and the respondent No.2 insurance company is liable to deposit the compensation amount.
Hence, I answer Issue No.4 in both cases accordingly and pass the following order.
ORDER MVC No.4021/2018 filed under Section 166 of IMV Act by Shivamma, Vanitha, Gouthami are hereby partly allowed.
